title: Consolidation: Public Administration, Ombudsman & Civic Rights

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can sum up in a few sentences how the ombudsman, the courts and civil organisations protect citizens' rights.
I can use verbs with -ra/-re, ellen, -nak/-nek, -tól/-től and -val/-vel in administrative sentences.
I can formulate formal legal submissions and evaluate the transparency of public administration.
